_comment: Level-0 knowledge regions = the high-level sections of the portfolio, painted as zones on the cortex. `position` is an [x,y,z] anchor in the brain's local space (front = +z, up = +y). Regions are spread across the surface so the per-pixel Voronoi paint gives each a distinct, non-overlapping zone. `blurb` is the one-line recruiter summary shown on hover. Content is mapped to regions deterministically by source/type in build-tree.js — never by tag similarity.
